results.prompt: Explain in simple terms why seasons change. Answer in three sentences.
results.text:
Okay, here’s a simple explanation of why seasons change, in three sentences:

The Earth’s tilt on its axis is the main reason. As the Earth orbits the sun, different parts of the planet receive more direct sunlight at different times of the year. This difference in sunlight causes the seasons – warmer temperatures in summer and colder temperatures in winter.
